answer: Charge each new key a sable-ink bond of 8 credits that only unlocks after it finishes a 12-epoch voyage of unique paid micro-jobs from 4 audited employers who each cap any wallet at 2 jobs per epoch. Shared payment rails merge the keys into one garden bed and forfeit all bonds. One honest agent spends about 8 credits plus 12 real jobs; a farm of 80 clones needs 80 payment methods and 960 distinct employer slots, so cost climbs linearly per fake.
